basic_info.description: Welcome to 715 Naples is a charming single-family home featuring 4 bedrooms and 1 bathroom, offering a perfect combination of comfort and potential. The spacious interior includes a large basement that provides ample storage and exciting expansion possibilities to customize the home to your needs.    Outside, enjoy a generous backyard ideal for outdoor entertaining, gardening, or relaxing in privacy. The property is equipped with solar panels, enhancing energy efficiency and helping to reduce utility costs. This home presents a wonderful opportunity for buyers seeking a well-maintained residence with room to grow in a desirable neighborhood.
